title: fix(metadata-protocol, cli)!: a package-less item of a name two packages hold is refused at both exact addresses for every narrowed type, and the layered read judges its exact address (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgBGRab1DeGu4CYzNsYSXWbg)_
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXMPeaveqRdwRZKKQP

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一条没有绑定包的定制（包外行）如果所在名字被两个包同时持有，按包精确读（`?package=X`）一律 409 并列出所有持有者；此前只对已接好按包读取的类型生效，现在凡是已经放宽到"每命名空间一个"的类型（目前是 action）也生效。
- 也补了 layered 读（`?layers=true&package=X`）：它以前只做准入，不判断读到的代码层和存储行是谁的，会把包外行当成每个持有者的 overlay 报出来，现在与普通读同样判断。
- 为什么：ADR-0150 D4，包外行只能是一个持有者的定制，两个持有者时无法判断归属，必须拒绝而不是两边都给；专题裁决要求这个拒绝在类型放宽之前到位。
- 风险：只收紧读的应答，不改存储；一方持有、已绑定到某个包的行照旧服务。三个第一方应用启动实测没有被两个包同时持有的名字，仓库内没有应答变化。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 32407`，预期 11 例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位审查并落地。

Fixes #32407

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` exports `judgesPackageLessRows` (a widened public surface), and reads that served now refuse (FROM → TO below).
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no exact or layered read of a package-less item of a name two packages hold (the `/layers` hits in `content/docs/` are the route's reference rows and release notes); the prescription ships in the refusal text and the FROM → TO below.

`Metadata-protocol: none` because nothing an author can write changes: the change is whether a read answers or refuses, and the stored metadata is read exactly as before. `Clause-②` is `yes` for the new export and carries the one `(narrowing)` arm for the reads. The precedent is #32244 (a new export plus the bare action read's 409), declared the same way; the seat accepted this reading.

## What changes

ADR-0150 D4: a package-less item (the environment's item, or a `sys_metadata` row bound to no package) is the customization of ONE holder. With two holders it cannot say which, so each exact address refuses it. #32214 carries that refusal (`exactQualifierItem`, `packageLessRowOwners`), but only for types the registry reads by `(package, name)` (`PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`). Epic ruling 6761802819 requires the refusal to be in place before a type narrows.

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`: new exported predicate `judgesPackageLessRows(registry, type)`: a type ADR-0150 addresses by package whose readers consult `(package, name)` OR whose one-holder rule has narrowed to the namespace (`NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`, core). `packageLessRowOwners` asks it instead of `readsByPackage` alone. A type joins the refusal in the same change that narrows it, whether or not its readers are wired.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` (epic read 6792024828 S2, ledger item 6777952260): `getMetaItemLayered` keeps the address `admitExactQualifier` returns and judges it as `getMetaItem` does. The code layer goes through `exactQualifierItem`. The stored row is stamped with the binding the plain read states for it (`withRowBinding`, or the declared override's base) and goes through `exactQualifierItem` too: a refusal is thrown, and a row that is not the address's is no layer of it. The raw row is still what `overlay` reports.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`: `os migrate stored-references` lists the package-less rows of every type `judgesPackageLessRows` judges (it read `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` only), so the rows refused above are named with their candidates.

### Step 1, measured on 27abd458a8 (#32214's final head)

Package-scoped types outside `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` that are narrowed now or will be, read from each branch or card:

| Type | Narrowed by | In the read set? | Judged after this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | #31697 (on main) | no | yes, through the narrowed set |
| `flow` | #31696 PR-3 (branch `wqgmuu`, read at 0ecd1ff48) | joins both sets in that PR | yes, either way |
| `webhook`, `connector` | #31699 PR 2 / PR 3 | not yet | yes, from the change that adds them to the narrowed set |
| `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset`, `api` | #31700 (branch `du44hj`, read at a9779e0f1) | already | yes, as before |
| `function` | #31700 | not a metadata type (not in `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES`) | no; nothing is stored under it |
| `tool` | #31985 (PR #32081) | already | yes, as before |

What `action` actually answered at the start sha (same fixture as the pins):

- A package-less environment item in the registry (registered with no package, or a stored row hydrated with `_packageId` `''` or `sys_metadata`) of a name alpha and beta ship: `?package=alpha` and `?package=beta` both served it. **This is the gap.**
- A stored package-less `sys_metadata` row of a shipped action is already declined at each holder's plain exact read (ADR-0126 Regime C, `declinesStoredRow`): each served its own action, and each list its own. Unchanged.
- The layered read `?layers=true&package=X` reported the package-less stored row as the `overlay` of both holders, for `email_template` (a read-set type) and `action` alike.

## FROM → TO

| Read | FROM | TO | Clause-② arm | Pin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /meta/action/NAME?package=<holder>` (and the qualified path), environment item package-less, two holders | 200, the environment item, at both holders | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `ambiguous-in-closure`, naming both | narrowing | `two holders: both exact reads of the environment's item (stamp …)` ×3 |
| `?layers=true&package=<holder>`, package-less stored row, two holders, any judged type (`email_template`, `action`, …) | 200, the row as that holder's `overlay` | 409, same refusal | narrowing | `two holders: ?layers=true&package=X of a package-less row refuses 409` |
| `os migrate stored-references`, package-less `action` row of a two-holder name | not listed | listed with both candidates | none (a report) | `[#32407] a narrowed type its readers do not read by package (action) is listed too` |
| `packageLessRowOwners(registry, type, name)` (exported since #31699) on a registry whose `readsByPackage(type)` is `false`, for a narrowed type (`action`, `email_template`, …) | `[]` | every holder | narrowing (only a registry that does not read the type by package: a test double or an embedder's engine; `SchemaRegistry` reads `email_template` by package) | `[#32407] a type narrowed to the namespace is judged whether or not the registry reads it by package` (the #31699 CONTROL that read `email_template` there now reads `page` and `hook`) |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: one holder serves the package-less item (plain and layered); an item or row bound to one holder is served on that holder only; the stored package-less row of a shipped action stays declined at the plain read; the bare action read keeps #32244's 409; the layered code layer stays the holder's own; each holder's list serves its own.

A stored package-less row of a shipped action is declined by the plain read and refused by the layered read. That is deliberate: the plain read never serves the row there, while the layered read used to report it as that holder's overlay, which is the attribution D4 forbids with two holders.

## Serial

- After #32214. Before #31699 PR 2 (webhook) and PR 3 (connector): each rides this gate the moment it adds its type to `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`.
- Trial merges at this head: `du44hj` (#31700) and `wqgmuu` (#31696 PR-3) gain no conflict from this PR. `phk4r9` (PR #32497) conflicts in one line of `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` (`const exactAddress = await admitExactQualifier(…)`: keep this PR's line).
- Merge of main after PR #32551 (#32365): one conflict, in `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`. Resolved by keeping main's bare action block (`judgeBareActionRead`, which replaced `refuseActionHeldByPackages` there) whole and binding its `admitExactQualifier` call to `exactAddress`. The two do not overlap: the bare answer runs only with no `packageId`, the exact-address judging only with one.
- Epic seat ruling on the interaction with PR #32497 (#32183), verbatim:

  > #32407 does not touch packageLessRowOwners' treatment of disabled holders and moves no answer on the read-set types. Excluding disabled holders at the exact door is #32497's hunk under the #32183 ruling A. The only extra duty falls on whichever PR lands second: at the layered merge point it keeps both effects, #32407's widened gate and #32497's exclusion of disabled holders, and adds the one pin for that combined shape.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, new describe `[#32407] …` (11 cases, in the shared file): the premise; two holders × three stamps of the environment item (both exact reads 409 naming both, both lists serve their own); CONTROLs for one holder, after a bind, the declined stored row of a shipped action, and the bare read's #32244 refusal; the layered read: two holders refused for `email_template` and `action`, one holder reported, after a bind, and the code layer stays the holder's own.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.test.ts`: one case for the widened gate; the #31699 CONTROL it moved now reads types neither read by package nor narrowed.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.literal-namespace.test.ts`: one case.
- Red first on 27abd458a8: 4 objectql cases and the CLI case fail; green after.
- Ablation (once): `judgesPackageLessRows` back to `readsByPackage` only turns the same 5 red; restored.
- First-party census: crm, showcase and multi-package booted; over the 16 judged types, 216 names, 0 held by two packages.

## Gates

Final head e020075ca (origin/main 9cd5fc161 merged in, which carries #32551; never rebased):

- `dispatch-gates --commands` on the 8 changed paths: 69 families, all exit 0, `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` (with #32649) among them. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0).
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- Typecheck: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 0, `@objectstack/objectql` 0, `@objectstack/cli` 0 (with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`; the default heap ran out of memory in `check:test-typecheck` here).
- Suites: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 336 files / 22739 passed; `@objectstack/objectql` 587 / 12384 passed; `@objectstack/cli` 631 / 7877 passed.
- Dogfood battery (`@objectstack/dogfood`, full, at 9ef100102, before the last main merges): 451 files / 3780 passed / 42 skipped, 0 failed. Not re-run after the merges; CI's dogfood gate runs on the head.

## Acceptance notes

- The plain exact read of a stored package-less row of a shipped action is declined, not refused (Regime C), while the row is only stored; only the layered read refuses it. Once the row is hydrated into the registry it is the environment item of FROM → TO row 1, and refused there.
- New finding, not folded in (measured at the final head, same fixture): the strict draft read (`state: 'draft'`) and `previewDrafts` at `?package=X` return before `exactQualifierItem`, so a package-less draft row of an `email_template` name alpha and beta hold is served at both exact addresses. Tracked in #32568 (Blocked-by #32407); this PR moves nothing there.
- New finding, not folded in (measured at the final head, same fixture): `hook`, `job`, `queue`, `sharing_rule` and `assignment_rule` have no one-holder rule, so the registry takes the same name from two packages; a package-less environment item of such a name is served at both holders' `?package=`. These types are outside both sets, so this PR does not judge them. Tracked in #32568 (the same card); this PR moves nothing there.
